items.quote: Update: tested it out myself on their Max plan, on some parallel agentic sessions. Currently 20% of my 5 hour limit and 4% of my weekly limit. Total: 58.46M; GLM-5.3 Cached: 56.91M; GLM-5.3 Uncached: 1.23M; GLM-5.3 Output: 315.18K; Cache hit rate: 97.9%. Extrapolating: Full 5-hour 292.3M; Full weekly 1.461B. All of the work was off-peak I think, using OpenCode not ZCode in these examples.
items.limitations: Best V3 absolute-token+% pair found this round. 58.46M/0.04=1.461B/week; 58.46M/0.20=292.3M/5h. 5h:week % ratio matches designed 28k:140k credits (=1:5). Official EN 98%-cache Max GLM-5.3 off-peak upper is 1,463M — observed extrapolated week lands on that upper. Integer 4% band ≈3.5–4.5% → week ≈1.30–1.67B. Not a saturated week; token totals are harness/session logs not panel OCR; peak/off-peak self-reported. Parent thread is GLM-5.3 launch (HN 49294997, ~2026-08-14).
